name: gantt-chart
title: Gantt chart
description: A project-plan timeline: a pinned task list beside a scrollable day/week/month timeline of bars, milestones, and roll-up summary brackets, with finish-to-start dependency arrows, a today marker, weekend shading, collapsible groups, and task rescheduling by drag, edge-drag resizing, or keyboard chords behind a confirmable move gate.
